body:
Four dialects and capability discovery. Postgres renders numbered $n placeholders and double-quoted identifiers. SQLite uses ? and double quotes; MySQL and ClickHouse use ? and backticks. Postgres and SQLite implement RETURNING; MySQL and ClickHouse decline it. Dialect requires Placeholder and QuoteIdent, while optional interfaces add capabilities. Small interfaces let external dialects participate without a registry change.

Evidence: ds:block?id=dialect-contract-smkbmeyz; ds:block?id=dialect-matrix-efpaw6ht. See docs/architecture.md and docs/operating-notes.md. Verified from the implementation and tests on 2026-11-01; server-test gates are explicitly distinguished from execution.
